evidence_class: measured (raw session.json/raw.jsonl per run retained under runs/; stage profiles under stage_runs/)

machine_lease.policy: exclusive while sweeping; operator parked heavy work
machine_lease.loadavg_before_each_run: recorded in runs/*.log and stage_runs/driver.log lease lines

arms.import_path_assert: profile_stages asserts import under the declared src root; batch workers.json records una_pkg.__file__ per worker (spot-verified base_8x1 -> main/src, cand runs -> wt-integration/src)

workload.name: W3_medium_proxy
workload.manifest_sha256s: see /tmp/workloads/W3_medium_proxy/manifest.json (network 345e172a...); counts: 15400 network edges, 2560 origins, 2560 destinations, graph 7360 nodes / 30800 directed incidences
workload.recalibration_note: W3 resized 46x40/320/640 -> 92x80/2560/2560 BEFORE any recorded L3/L4 measurement so a job is ~1.6 s baseline (documented in workload_gen.py)

sweep_protocol.mode: batch (spawn-style persistent workers, bounded queue, warm-up excluded from timed window)
sweep_protocol.order: candidate then baseline per config; 8x1 last (highest potential memory pressure)
sweep_protocol.timed_window: dispatch-through-last-result; producers block on the bounded queue so dispatch is included
sweep_protocol.jits_caches: NUMBA_CACHE_DIR routed to venvs/nbc_cand and venvs/nbc_base; never into either source tree

harness_incidents: Incident 1 (fixed pre-evidence): spawn workers died on import - sys.path is fixed at interpreter start so a PYTHONPATH set inside _worker_entry was invisible; fixed by explicit sys.path insertion + fail-fast readiness barrier.

Incident 2 (fixed pre-evidence): base_2x4 first attempt - concurrent workers raced writing ONE shared warm-up GeoJSON; GDAL cannot overwrite an existing dataset so the loser died DataSourceError. Fixed with per-worker warm-up dirs. The failed attempt's runner then hung in multiprocessing's atexit join of the surviving worker; fixed by terminating workers on any barrier/collection exception. Rerun completed 12/0 (tput 1.912).

Incident 3 (operator): stage-model part 1 of the first sweep attempted before the W3 fixture existed (runner generates fixtures, profile_stages does not) - all 10 stage runs failed fast with FileNotFoundError and were rerun in part 3 after fixtures existed. Failed attempt logs retained in stage_runs/driver.log.
No measurement above was taken while any incident was active; each affected run was rerun clean.
